req.title: Task title accepts unicode
req.statement: The system shall accept task titles containing UTF-8 characters and return them intact.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that task titles must accept UTF-8 characters. This necessitates testing with various UTF-8 inputs, including typical, boundary, and invalid cases, to ensure the system handles them correctly.

tests.name: test_create_task_with_unicode_title
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running in-process.
The database is initialized and accessible.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a task title containing UTF-8 characters.
expected: The response JSON contains the task title with UTF-8 characters intact.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={
        "title": "Tâsk Tïtle with Ünicode",
        "description": "A task with unicode characters in the title",
        "completed": False
    }
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == "Tâsk Tïtle with Ünicode"

tests.name: test_create_task_with_empty_title
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running in-process.
The database is initialized and accessible.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with an empty task title.
expected: The response JSON contains a validation error for the title field.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={
        "title": "",
        "description": "A task with an empty title",
        "completed": False
    }
)

assert response.status_code == 422
assert "value_error.any_str.min_length" in str(response.json())

tests.name: test_create_task_with_max_length_title
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running in-process.
The database is initialized and accessible.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a task title of maximum allowed length (100 characters).
expected: The response JSON contains the task title with 100 characters intact.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

max_length_title = "T" * 100
response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={
        "title": max_length_title,
        "description": "A task with a maximum length title",
        "completed": False
    }
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == max_length_title
